ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 45% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels and 55% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large irregular high-intensity patch with multiple low-intensity circular inclusions in the mid-section. Right lobe displays predominantly low-intensity pixels with high-intensity linear streaks radiating towards the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 55-degree interior angle with a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with peaks and valleys; higher amplitude serrations (approx. 10-15 pixels) on the upper half of the left lobe's trailing edge compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge boundary of both lobes, terminating in sharp convex curves at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous high-intensity linear streaks; prominent near-vertical white scratch on the lower right lobe near the notch and a network of thin horizontal scratches across the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring patterns including linear rake marks and circular barnacle attachment scars across the entirety of the visible fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A single orange/tan-colored protruding object (sessile barnacle) is visible attached to the extreme superior-lateral tip of the left lobe.
